---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for LinkVault
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement

A clear description of the problem or limitation this feature would address.

> Example: "I can't add a Mastodon link because there's no built-in Mastodon icon in the Studio."

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative approaches or workarounds you've considered.

## Scope

Which part of LinkVault does this affect?

- [ ] Public website (profile page)
- [ ] Local Studio (visual editor)
- [ ] GitHub Actions / deployment workflow
- [ ] Configuration / `profile.json` schema
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other: ___

## Would you be willing to contribute a pull request?

- [ ] Yes, I'd like to implement this myself
- [ ] I could help review or test a PR
- [ ] No, I'm requesting it for someone else to implement

## Additional Context

Add mockups, links to similar implementations, or any extra context here.
